Interface EmailAddressRequestRepository

All Known Implementing Classes:
JdbcEmailAddressRequestRepository
public interface EmailAddressRequestRepository
Stores the requests to add or change an email address, one per identity.

  • Method Details

    • save

      boolean save(EmailAddressRequest request, String tokenHash, String codeHash, Duration resendInterval)
      Saves the identity's request in place of an older one, unless one was made too recently: by this identity for any address, or by anyone for this address, within resendInterval.
      Parameters:
      request - the request
      tokenHash - the SHA-256 hash of the link's token
      codeHash - the keyed hash of the code, bound to the request's id
      resendInterval - how long a request holds off another
      Returns:
      whether it was saved

    • consumeToken

      Optional<EmailAddressRequest> consumeToken(UUID identityId, String tokenHash, Instant now)
      Consumes the identity's live request with the token.
      Parameters:
      identityId - the identity confirming; a token works only for the identity that asked
      tokenHash - the SHA-256 hash of the presented token
      now - the current time
      Returns:
      the request, or empty if none matches

    • attemptCode

      Optional<EmailAddressCodeAttempt> attemptCode(UUID identityId, int maxAttempts, Instant now)
      Counts a code attempt against the identity's live request, if it has attempts left.
      Parameters:
      identityId - the identity confirming
      maxAttempts - how many attempts a code allows
      now - the current time
      Returns:
      the request's id and code hash, or empty if there is no live request with attempts left

    • consumeCode

      Optional<EmailAddressRequest> consumeCode(UUID requestId, String codeHash, Instant now)
      Consumes a live request whose code hash matches.
      Parameters:
      requestId - the request
      codeHash - the presented code's hash
      now - the current time
      Returns:
      the request, or empty if it was used, expired or the hash differs
